title: fix(plugin-detail,app-shell): offer reactions only on comment rows of a record's discussion feed (objectui#11035)
body:
Fixes #11035
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

A reaction is stored on the comment, in `sys_comment.reactions`. The record page's discussion feed merges two reads: `sys_comment` rows, which become feed kind `comment`, and `sys_activity` rows (a field change, a completed task, a system event), which `activityRowToFeedItem` turns into other kinds. `RecordActivityTimeline` rendered the Add reaction button on every root row, with no gate on the row's kind. Picking an emoji on an activity row handed the host the activity's id, and `RecordDetailView`'s `handleToggleReaction` wrote `dataSource.update('sys_comment', ID, …)` for whatever id it got.

Premise check on `origin/main` `bf7ab35`: reproduced before any source change. The new app-shell pin below, over the real record page with one `sys_comment` row and one `sys_activity` row, found two Add reaction buttons on the panel, and picking 👍 through each one issued `sys_comment` updates keyed `a1` (the activity) and `c1` (the comment): `expected [ 'a1', 'c1' ] to not include 'a1'`.

**What marks a row's kind.** The feed item already carries it as `item.type`, and the gate reads that field, not an id pattern. `RecordDetailView` builds every `sys_comment` row as `type: 'comment'` (the read, and the two rows the composer adds). A `sys_activity` row goes through `activityRowToFeedItem`: its kinds are the values of `ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE` plus the unmapped fallback `system`, and `comment` is not among them. The plugin-detail pin below drives every built-in `sys_activity` type the spec declares, plus an author-extended one, through that reading and checks each renders no reaction control.

**Every reaction surface on a row.** Two surfaces render per root row: the reaction chips (which toggle on click) with the Add reaction button, and the Add reaction button alone when the row has no reactions yet. Both now take the same per-row handler. Replies rendered by `ThreadedReplies` have no reaction surface at all. With threading off a reply renders as a root row, and a reply is always a `sys_comment` row, so it keeps its reactions.

## What changed

- **`RecordActivityTimeline` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`).** A new module-local `canStoreReaction(item)` answers `item.type === 'comment'`. The per-row toggle handler exists only when reactions are enabled, the host passed `onToggleReaction`, and the row is a comment. A row that is not a comment renders no Add reaction button. If a host hands it reactions, they render as chips with no handler, which `ReactionPicker` already renders disabled. Comment rows keep their Add reaction button and clickable chips, unchanged.
- **`RecordDetailView` (`@object-ui/app-shell`), the handler guard beside the gate.** `handleToggleReaction` now returns without a write when the id's feed row is not a comment (`if (!row || row.type !== 'comment') return;`). It is not the fix on its own: the render gate is. It covers any other consumer of the page's `DiscussionContext`.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` said reactions toggle "on any feed item". The features line, the `enableReactions` row and the two `onToggleReaction` rows now say only a comment row offers them.
- **Changeset** `11035-reactions-comment-rows-only.md`: `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.

No change to how comment reactions are stored (that was PR objectui#11034 for objectui#11019), and no server change.

## Tests

New `RecordActivityTimeline.reactionsCommentRowsOnly-11035.test.tsx` (plugin-detail, real `RecordActivityTimeline` and `ReactionPicker`, activity rows built by the real `activityRowToFeedItem`):
1. A mixed feed (one comment, one `created` activity) has exactly one Add reaction, inside the comment's row. Picking 👍 hands the host `('c1', '👍')` once.
2. One case per `sys_activity` type that reaches a panel (the spec's `SYS_ACTIVITY_BUILTIN_TYPES` minus the four the reading drops, plus `author_extended_kind`): the activity row offers no Add reaction, the comment beside it does, and the handler is never called. A guard case keeps the list from being empty.
3. One case per spec `FeedItemType` other than `comment`: a row carrying reactions shows the chip disabled and no Add reaction, and clicking the chip calls nothing.
4. Control: a comment row carrying reactions keeps an enabled chip and its Add reaction, and a chip click hands `('c1', '👍')`.

New `RecordDetailView.reactionsCommentRowsOnly-11035.test.tsx` (app-shell, real `RecordDetailView` over a fake data source answering one `sys_comment` row and one `sys_activity` row):
1. The activity row shows no Add reaction button and the comment row shows one.
2. Picking 👍 through every Add reaction on the panel issues exactly one update, `['sys_comment', 'c1']`, storing `{"👍":["u1"]}`. No update is keyed by `a1`.
3. A probe registered on the same page reads `DiscussionContext` and calls the handler with `a1`: no write. Control: the same probe with `c1` writes `['sys_comment', 'c1']`.

**Red on `main`.** Both new files, run against the unmodified sources at `bf7ab35`: 25 failed, 2 passed (27). The 2 that passed are the comment-row control and the non-empty-list guard.

**Green** at `8bc1d5040`: 27 passed (27).

**Ablations (one-off, not kept).** Run after the fix was committed at `8bc1d5040`, each under a trap that restores the file from `HEAD`:
- *Render gate removed* (`RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` checked out from `bf7ab35`; on disk its hash equalled the base blob and `canStoreReaction` counted 0): 23 failed, 4 passed. Every plugin-detail pin except the two controls went red, and so did app-shell pin 1. App-shell pins 2 and 3 stayed green, because the handler guard alone still refused the activity id.
- *Handler guard removed* (`RecordDetailView.tsx` from `bf7ab35`, hash equal to the base blob, the guard text counted 0): 1 failed, 26 passed. Only app-shell pin 3 went red (`update` called once, for `a1`). The render gate alone kept every panel-driven pin green.
- Both restores were proven by the file hash equal to the `HEAD` blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Local gates (head `8bc1d5040`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`: 218 files passed, 1 skipped. 2149 tests passed, 8 skipped.
- 88 test files outside plugin-detail that name `RecordDetailView`, `RecordActivityTimeline`, `RecordChatterPanel`, `record:discussion`, `record:activity`, `record:chatter` or `onToggleReaction` (71 in app-shell, plus apps/console, types, i18n, cli and plugin-tree), in two batches: 45 files with 622 tests, and 43 files with 922 tests, all passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/`: 177 files passed, 2 skipped. 5351 tests passed, 2 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exits 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (28 tasks). Both `tsconfig.test.json` programs list the new test files (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `eslint --format json` on the 4 touched TypeScript files (the JSON reports 4 files): 0 errors. `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` has 0 warnings and `RecordDetailView.tsx` has 111, the same counts as their base versions linted through `--stdin`. The new app-shell test has 4 `no-explicit-any` warnings, the same style as its objectui#11019 sibling. No file is ignored by the config. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-fence-languages` and `check-doc-example-ids` all exit 0. `check-changeset-claims` points at pending `7997-detail-view-related-retired.md`, which names `RecordDetailView.tsx`. That paragraph is about the retired `DetailView.related` schema and is still true after this diff.
- No import was added to any source file, so the console's eager graph does not move and Bundle Analysis has nothing new to measure.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 6 changed paths answers NOT GOVERNED.

**Declared narrowing.** The whole app-shell suite was not run locally. The narrowing is the 88 files above: every test that names the changed view, the timeline, the blocks that mount it, or the reaction handler. The full suite is CI's.

**NOT MEASURED locally: `check:doc-snippets`.** It refused with exit 2 (precondition not met) until 34 packages are built. The docs edit changes prose in a bullet list and three table rows, and no fenced code block. CI runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- Read only, not filed: `enableReactions` in `@object-ui/types` (`RecordActivityComponentProps`) is documented "Enable emoji reactions on activities". After this change the control renders only on comments. Carrier: none.
- Read only, not filed: `mergeFeedRows` merges the `sys_comment` and `sys_activity` reads by id alone. A comment and an activity with the same id would share one row. Not measured, carrier: none.
